quote.text:
Parts of Florida remained underwater Thursday, with schools closed, residents stranded and little relief in sight as forecasters warned of more downpours.

Videos showed neighborhoods submerged. In Palm Bay, emergency crews used boats to evacuate residents.

media.title: Extreme flooding sets records in Florida, with more rain to come
media.description: The flooding kept schools closed in parts of Florida on Thursday as forecasters warned of more downpours along the state’s east coast.
